summary: Accepted after independent re-review. The revised behavior oracle observes exact task/queue/issue subgrammars, traps HTTP(S)/ALL proxy connections for offline llm, requires the exact five TypeScript artifacts and Defer task client methods, and checks every render exit status before content. Separate release-mode efficiency and stability cases close the RuntimeTool dimension ceiling with non-zero work, exact generated artifacts, hard latency/time/FD thresholds, deterministic output, and temporary-state cleanup. Independent execution passed behavior 5/5, efficiency 20 operations at 4.923ms median and 6.112ms p99 with zero errors, and stability 256 CLI operations plus 16 codegen rounds in 1379ms with FD 4 -> 4 and zero errors.
